summary.en: A threat on a flower show artist causes Kogoro Mouri to be hired during a local flower show, but when one of the guests is murdered. Location: Bay Front Hotel Victim: Daisuke Shiraki Cause of death: Strangulation Suspects: Katagiri Anaconda and Rika Okano The victim was first put to sleep with chloroform then kill by a tie. Conan must find a way to prevent yet another possible murder from happening during the same show.
